label: Bible Study
prompt: For then will I turn to the people a pure _____, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
verse: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
note: A promise to reverse Babel — one pure language, everyone calling on the LORD together.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall _____.
verse: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
note: In Luke's Beatitudes, the ones who weep now are promised a turn at laughing — tears are not the last word.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage _____ of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
verse: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
note: Revelation's best invitation: blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb.

label: Deep Water
prompt: My days are swifter than a weaver's _____, and are spent without hope.
verse: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.
note: A weaver's shuttle flies back and forth faster than the eye can follow — Job says his days go like that.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And have no fellowship with the _____ works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
verse: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
note: Darkness produces nothing worth keeping: its works are 'unfruitful' — so don't join in; expose them.
